newsitem.title: UK: Oasis star Gallagher cancels marriage over media.
newsitem.headline: Oasis star Gallagher cancels marriage over media.

text.p: Liam Gallagher, singer with top British rock band Oasis, cancelled his wedding to actress Patsy Kensit at the last minute on Monday, blaming the media for removing all dignity from the occasion.
"Contrary to media speculation, Liam Gallagher will not be marrying Ms Patsy Kensit today," Oasis's record company Creation said in a statement.
"Obsessive and intrusive media attention has removed any dignity from what was to be a private and special occasion."

The venue of his marriage to actress Patsy Kensit had remained a closely-guarded secret. Reporters and photographers had camped outside their north London home throughout the weekend in the hope of discovering the location. Liam, 24, who actively cultivates a bad-boy image, is rarely out of the newspapers.

In January he was let off with a caution after police found him in possession of cocaine. Last year he failed to join the rest of the band at the start of a concert tour in the United States, leading to reports Oasis would break up.

Elder brother Noel, the creative force of the band, has a stormy relationship with Liam and can be just as outspoken. He was condemned by members of parliament last month for saying drug-taking was now as normal as drinking tea for young Britons.
Kensit, a blond actress whose screen career has failed to live up to its early promise, has been married twice before. Jim Kerr, singer of rock band Simple Minds, was her second husband.
